svg.title: Enthalpies at 30 °C and saturation (ethanol–water, 1 kg/cm²)
svg.text: Ethanol–water enthalpy–composition chart at 1 kg/cm² (after Bosnjakovic; Wankat Fig. 2-4), redrawn
Auxiliary line for interpolating equilibrium compositions
Find the composition on the x axis (H₁, h_D at 0.85; h_F at 0.25; h_B at 0.02).
Go up to the curve: dew line, boiling line, or a 30 °C liquid line drawn halfway between the 20 °C and 40 °C isotherms (dashed).
Go across to the enthalpy axis (the nearer side).
Read H₁ ≈ 309, h_D ≈ 17 and h_F ≈ 21 (30 °C), h_B ≈ 97 kcal/kg.
Redrawn from the chart data (curves fitted to the readings used in the solutions); in the exam read the printed chart — values may differ slightly.
